name: Alpha Strike
summary: Hadoken Swiftstrider has a plan to break the impasse with the Woodpaw gnolls: strike down several of their leaders, who call themselves Alphas, in quick succession. Hadoken wants you to be the one to carry it out.

sections.title: Five Alphas in an Hour
sections.body: Hadoken reasons that if the gnoll leaders, who call themselves Alphas, fall one after another, their ranks will be thrown into chaos. It might also send the message that the Horde can and will destroy them. You are to carry out Hadoken's will: five Alphas down inside a single hour, or the stalemate stays.

sections.title: Afterwards
sections.body: Thinned ranks and slain leaders, Hadoken expects, will make the gnolls hesitate before storming the camp. Yet the trouble is not over. Hadoken wants to learn what has driven the gnolls into such a frenzy, and to do so ahead of their regrouping.

faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider, who is dealing with the stalemate against the Woodpaw gnolls for the Horde.
The plan only works if the Alphas fall in swift succession, since that is what should throw the gnoll ranks into chaos. Five must fall within an hour.
They are leaders among the Woodpaw gnolls, who call themselves Alphas.

faq.q: How many Alphas must I kill?
faq.answer: Five, all within one hour, before returning to Hadoken Swiftstrider.
